newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki off ahead of Nokia Q2, U.S. payrolls.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki off ahead of Nokia Q2, U.S. payrolls.

text.p: Finnish shares were lower in quiet afternoon trade on Friday ahead of Nokia's Q2 results on Monday and with activity subdued as the market awaited U.S. July jobs data due at 1530/1230 GMT, brokers said.
Nokia was 4.50 markka down at 470.00 matching its lower overnight close on Wall Street.
Outokumpu was 2.20 markka up at 106.20, pulling the FOX index 1.34 points up. Brokers said Outokumpu gained thanks to the strong dollar and firm zinc prices.
One house actively bought UPM shares. A broker at the house referred to "overseas interest", but declined further comment.
The market was also gearing up for Nokia's Q2 results, due on Monday around 1600/1300 GMT.
A Reuters poll of 23 analysts put Nokia's six month profit before tax and minorities at 3.09 billion markka (range 2,966-3,300 markka), up from 1.13 billion in the first half of 1996.

"It (the profit) should be around 3,3 billion markka to boost the share up to 500 markka," one broker said. * Shares inch down as Nokia eases to match lower U.S. close. Market edgy awaiting U.S. July payrolls due 1230 GMT, brokers say. Strong zinc, dollar help Outokumpu buck trend, pulling FOX 1.34 pts up. Heavy trade in UPM, one brokerage active buyer.
